text: Figure 5.9: One-dimensional array (dynamic length) In the one-dimensional array one length field is used, which carries the number of bytes used for the array. The number of static length elements can be easily calculated by dividing by the size of an element. In the case of dynamical length elements the number of elements cannot be calculated, but the elements must be parsed sequentially.
